Find out about the latest updates, new features, and bug fixes in recent Photoshop releases.

- Send layers directly to Firefly Boards.
Send layers directly to Firefly Boards for creative exploration. Right-click one or more layers and select Send layers to Firefly Boards to send your work for more ideation, comparison, and creative exploration.


- Send layers directly to Firefly Boards for creative exploration. Right-click one or more layers and select Send layers to Firefly Boards to send your work for more ideation, comparison, and creative exploration.
- Get prompt tips for better image generations
Generate Image now displays contextual tips in the prompt bar to help you write more effective prompts and get better results from your generations. 


- Generate Image now displays contextual tips in the prompt bar to help you write more effective prompts and get better results from your generations. 
- Access Remove tool options from the Contextual Task Bar
Access Remove tool options, including the Find distractions dropdown, Add to and Subtract from buttons, and Remove after each stroke option, directly from the Contextual Task Bar. 


- Access Remove tool options, including the Find distractions dropdown, Add to and Subtract from buttons, and Remove after each stroke option, directly from the Contextual Task Bar. 
- Save and restore your favorite fonts
Save and load your curated list of favorite fonts so you can quickly restore them after Preferences are reset or cleared.


- Save and load your curated list of favorite fonts so you can quickly restore them after Preferences are reset or cleared.
- Find cloud files faster
Use natural language keywords to quickly search for cloud files, folders, and generated assets, making it easier to find the content you need.


- Use natural language keywords to quickly search for cloud files, folders, and generated assets, making it easier to find the content you need.
- Fix cloud document file access errors

Fixed an issue where some cloud documents couldn't be opened due to Creative Cloud synchronization or sign-in session issues, with improved troubleshooting for newer Photoshop versions.


- Fixed an issue where some cloud documents couldn't be opened due to Creative Cloud synchronization or sign-in session issues, with improved troubleshooting for newer Photoshop versions.
- Send layers directly to Firefly Boards for creative exploration. Right-click one or more layers and select Send layers to Firefly Boards to send your work for more ideation, comparison, and creative exploration.
- Generate Image now displays contextual tips in the prompt bar to help you write more effective prompts and get better results from your generations. 
- Access Remove tool options, including the Find distractions dropdown, Add to and Subtract from buttons, and Remove after each stroke option, directly from the Contextual Task Bar. 
- Save and load your curated list of favorite fonts so you can quickly restore them after Preferences are reset or cleared.
- Use natural language keywords to quickly search for cloud files, folders, and generated assets, making it easier to find the content you need.

Download, cancel, or remove the model at any time
Hardware compatibility is checked automatically before download
Switch between cloud and on-device processing

### Enhancements

- File handling and preferences
A new preference allows users to open JPEG files as a regular layer rather than a locked background layer streamlining workflows for users who routinely unlock the background.

- Generative AI
Rotate objects directly on the canvas. Turn flat objects into rotatable elements and adjust their angle using on-canvas controls. Preview changes as you rotate, then render the final result at full resolution. After applying rotation, use Harmonize  to seamlessly blend the object into your composition.
Track generative credits usage with the Generative Credits Usage panel. This panel provides a clear breakdown of credit costs for generative features like Generative Fill  , Generate similar, and Adobe- and partner-powered AI models. 
Get more accurate and varied results with the updated Firefly Fill and Expand model. Generative Fill and Generative Expand now use the updated model, delivering sharper resolution, improved photorealism, better prompt understanding, and more varied outputs. Generate similar also uses this updated model for more consistent iterative results. 
Get improved results with Firefly Image Model 5 in Generative Fill. Use natural language prompts for more intuitive edits and higher-quality outputs with the latest Adobe Firefly models.
Upload multiple reference images when working with partner models like Flux and Gemini to better control composition, style, and output.
Create images from simple text prompts without leaving your workspace, review variations, and add the result directly to your canvas.
Choose your generative AI model with the updated model picker. The redesigned model picker in the Contextual Task Bar makes it easier to browse and select from available generative AI models, including Adobe Firefly and premium partner models. View model descriptions, credit costs, and capabilities at a glance before generating.

- Workflows
Organize your layers instantly with AI-powered Layer Cleanup. Automatically detect and remove empty layers, and rename layers with meaningful descriptions to keep complex documents structured. Preview and apply cleanup changes non-destructively with full undo support. 
Find and apply actions faster with the redesigned Actions panel. The updated Actions panel adds natural language search, suggested actions based on your image, and live canvas previews. Browse in-built actions, create your own, and streamline repetitive tasks. 
Move seamlessly between Photoshop and Firefly Boards. Send images to Firefly Boards to explore and organize ideas, then bring JPG and PNG files back to Photoshop for further editing.
Work more efficiently with an updated Contextual Task Bar that surfaces relevant actions based on your selection.

- Editing tools
Find and remove distractions with the enhanced Remove tool. Automatically detect and remove wires, people, and general distractions using Find Distractions, with options to review and refine before applying changes.
Make text adapt automatically to shapes and paths. Use Dynamic Text   to resize and reflow text within shapes like Circle, Arch, and Bow as you adjust layout and positioning.
Remove unwanted reflections from photos. Remove reflections from images shot through glass and generate a clearer result, with options to control output quality and separate reflection details.
The Filter Gallery now includes a foreground and background color picker for dual-color filters, giving you more control over stylized effects.  
Control brush opacity separately from the resize HUD. A new preference lets you disable opacity adjustments in the resize HUD when using brush and painting tools, so you can resize brushes without affecting opacity.

### Fixed issues
- Upgraded installations retained Firefly Image 3 as the default generative model after updating from an earlier version, instead of switching to the latest Firefly Fill & Expand model.

### Feature updates
- Enhance images instantly with the Clarity and dehaze adjustment layer to boost midtone contrast and reduce haze non-destructively.
- Add and control grain non-destructively using the Grain adjustment layer.
- Create smarter with AI by selecting the best model in Generative Fill and Generative Expand to match your creative intent.
- Remove unwanted objects or people with more consistent results using the updated Remove tool.
- Get consistent results by using Reference Image in Generative Fill to quickly match objects.

### Fixed issues
- When accessed via UXP, the new Clarity and Grain adjustment layers do not have a layer. 
- Clarity and dehaze adjustment layers were not recognized by UXP scripting.
- Dehaze adjustment not working for small images.
- Feather selection did not accept decimal values correctly when using commas instead of decimal points.
- [Hue, Saturation, and Lightness adjustments were unresponsive, and images could be dragged unexpectedly.](https://community.adobe.com/t5/photoshop-beta-bugs/hue-satureation-photoshop-beta/idi-p/15504473)

### Feature updates
- Scratch disk management is improved, with updated free space recommendations and optimized settings to ensure smoother performance.

### Fixed issues
- [Generate Image and Import Image options are visible in the marquee style dropdown in the tool Options bar.](https://community.adobe.com/t5/photoshop-ecosystem-discussions/bug-in-rectangle-marquee-tool/td-p/15251747)

[Select People hangs when added to an Action.](https://community.adobe.com/t5/photoshop-beta-bugs/p-select-people-hangs-when-added-to-an-action/idi-p/15521943)

### Feature updates
- Choose from new partner AI models in Generative Fill for more tailored results.
- Build realistic composites with precise lighting, color, and shadow matching using Harmonize.
- Get sharper, clearer images with the new Generative Upscale, powered by Topaz Labs.
- Import Adobe Stock photos directly into Photoshop without leaving your workspace.
- Export final Photoshop assets directly to the Adobe Cloud for faster collaboration.
- Generate videos in Firefly by sending Photoshop assets to kickstart creation.
- Apply Color and Vibrance adjustments non-destructively with the new adjustment layer.
- Achieve more accurate results with improved Select Subject and Remove Background.
- Browse Adobe Express templates from the Photoshop homescreen to start designs quickly.
- Create shared Projects to organize assets and collaborate in one place.
- Import and edit Firefly-generated images in Photoshop while keeping the original unchanged.
- Reduce noise and enhance detail with updated generative AI Denoise and Sharpen filters, partner AI models from Topaz Labs.
- Brushes, sliders, and transforms react immediately.
- Layers, blend modes, and text edits operate without lag.
- Complex, multi-layered files perform smoothly without dropped frames.
- File operations, like opening, filtering, and exporting, are faster.
- Controls, dialogs, taskbars, and panels have a modernized design.
- Keyboard navigation, text readability, and contrast are improved for better accessibility.
- Quiet Mode minimizes pop-ups and notifications to reduce distractions and maintain focus.

### System updates
- Photoshop 2026 v27.0 has dropped support for macOS Monterey (version 12), Windows 11 v22H2, and v21H2 devices.

### Version updates
- The current version of Photoshop 2026 (desktop) is 27.0.
- The current LTS version of Photoshop 2025 is 26.11.1.
